find:
tankScale: reducedMotion ? 1 : 0.6 + 0.4 * p,
      ring: convergeRing(p, reducedMotion),
replace:
tankScale: reducedMotion ? 1 : 0.6 + 0.4 * p,
      ring: { radius: reducedMotion ? 1 : 0.4 + 1.6 * p, opacity: 1 - p, arc: 1 },
why: `warp` given back the expanding ring it drew before issue #1120 (0.4 -> 2.0, fading out). Warp is the default style and the only one a player can choose, so this is the entrance the ruling on #718 was about: the arrival would again grow outward exactly as the death pulse does, the confusion issue #230 reported. Killed both at the animator and through `createEntityViews`, whose mid-entrance ring radius is the converging curve's.
killedBy: converge: an arrival gathers instead of expanding (issue #230) every style converges
warp animator entrance: fades and scales the tank in, ring converges
spawn animation (#199) holds the spawn ring at its OWN world-space radius, independent of the tank's scale
